Text:
This, IN SHAA ALLAH, will be the most
important KHUTBA I've ever delivered so far.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
So, please pay attention,
a special attention this time.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I will try to repeat the important points
and I want you to bear in mind that I'm

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
talking to you, you.
Don't say "he's talking to somebody else".

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Recently, I have come to a very important
conclusion about believing in God,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
and this started in the Muslim
Perspective issue of February 1987,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: with the title "Satan Believes in God."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
It dawned on me that throughout the Quran
we are taught

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
that the majority of believers in God
are going to Hell.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
In SURA 12, verse 103 says "most
people no matter what you do will not believe"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
and then in 106, we're told that
"the majority of those who believe will go to Hell."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: This is in SURA 12 verse 106, and then we read

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
in SURA Al-Mu'minûn, number 23
verses 84 through 90.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I'm gonna quote starting at 84.
"Say, to whom belongs the Earth and

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
everyone in it if you know? They will say
to God! Say would you then take need?

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: or how come you do not take heed?"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
"Say, who is the Lord of the Heavens, the seven
universes, the Lord with the great Dominion?

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: They will say "God!" Say "how come you do

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
not observe righteousness or do not
observe God?"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
"Say, in whose hand is the Kingship of
everything, over everything, the One that

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
can come to your help and does not need
any help, if you know? They will say: God!

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Say "how come you, you have been bewitched,
have been... have gone astray?" So,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: And in SURA 29 verse 61 says "if you ask them who created the Heavens and the Earth

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
and committed the Sun and the Moon? They
will say: God!" and then the verse ends by

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: asking "how come they deviated?"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
In SURA 29 verse 63,
it says "if you ask them who sends water

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
from the sky to revive dead land? They
will say: God! Say praise be to God, how

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
come most of them do not understand?"
So, all these verses and many more

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
throughout Quran tell us that people
believe in God. Satan believes in God, but

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
they're still going to Hell. Now why?
And the very important conclusion is you

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
do not believe in God unless you know
God as He really is with all His qualities,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
namely, especially that God runs everything,
that God is doing everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And this will shed a new
light on our submission to God,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
our acceptance of whatever is happening to
you personally, or in the world,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: to anybody, to anything, to any country.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
We do not believe in God unless we
believe that God is running everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And at this point, I would like to
suggest a ZIKR for you, something for you to do.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Every day, wherever you go, when you're
driving, or sitting, or you have

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
nothing to do, or even if you have
something to do, I want this to dominate

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: your life even mentally, even when you're doing something, I want you to repeat

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: always "God is running everything", "God is running everything." This is your new ZIKR, our new ZIKR.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Because it will, it will... the whole world will look different to you. When anything is happening that may turn you into

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: an objector, not a submitter, this will remind you that God is doing everything and that you are objecting.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
As a believer, you have no business
losing your temper, for example.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
You're not a believer if you lose your temper.
And as I said that at the beginning

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
of the KHUTBA, I'm talking to you.
Don't say "he's talking to somebody else."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I'm talking to you, yes you, Abdullah, Gatut,
Mohtasham, Ahmad, the other Ahmad,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Frank and so on. I am talking to you, every
one of you. You have no business losing

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
your temper because this indicates
you're objecting to something God is doing.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
We must know that God is doing
everything, even the things that Satan is

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: doing, they are following God's law.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
A good example in the Quran is before
the creation of Adam, God is telling the

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: angels "I'm putting on earth a representative"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
which in a nutshell says that God of
course knew that Adam was gonna be

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
duped by Satan, and will go down to Earth,
because after when Satan tricked Adam,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: God said "go down to Earth all of you."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
But this, before the creation of Adam,
God is telling the angels "I'm going to

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: place on the planet Earth a representative, the human being."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: So, even though Satan tempted Adam and Eve, God is doing everything

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
because everything is going in
accordance with God's will.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
This is our new ZIKR when you're
driving, when you're sitting, when you're

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
doing anything. Eventually, it's gonna
happen mentally every cell in your body

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: is gonna say "God is running everything."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And this is the true believer. This is
the believer in God who will not go to Hell.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: The majority of believers in God are

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
going to Hell because they do not
believe that God is running everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
In SURA 8 verse 17, a classic example
"it is not you who killed them" - that was

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
after the battle, one of the battles in
early Islam - "it is not you who killed

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
them, it is God who killed them. It is not
you who threw when you threw" the arrow

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: or the gun or whatever "it was God who threw."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And this is a very important conclusion
and this is why I think this is the most

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: important KHITBA I ever given to you.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I made a trip recently to Egypt
and everything that happened in

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: that trip told me that we don't do anything. We do not do anything. God is doing everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: The timing of my arrival, the timing of

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
my leaving, I mean, I get on the telephone
and say "TWA, I'm changing my reservation

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
from Tuesday to Thursday." I decided to
change my... I didn't decide anything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I didn't change anything. Believe me, God
is doing it. God is doing everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
In SURA number 12, again, the brothers of
Joseph decided not to kill him, right?

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: They think they decided not to kill him. They decided to throw him in the well.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: But before this happens, way before this, years before they make this so-called decision of theirs,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Joseph sees the dream, the Sun, the Moon and eleven stars bowing before him

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: which is his father, his mother, and his 11 brother bowing before him,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: something that was to happen after he's practically ruling Egypt as a man.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: So, one day the brothers met to kill him. They...

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: The decision was already made. They could not decide to kill him. It was impossible.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: But here they are meeting and they're taking votes "shall we kill him?"

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
"What shall we do with him?" And then
they decided, they think, not to kill him.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
God is running everything.
And this is our new ZIKR. Just keep telling

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
yourself "God is running everything"
especially when you are at the brink of

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
objecting to something or losing
your temper.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
When you lose your temper, tell
yourself "you must separate yourself from you

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
as of now." When you lose your temper
against a friend or a spouse or a brother or

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: a sister or anybody in the street, you tell yourself "you're not a Muslim.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: You're objecting." Because God is running everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Believe me. When your friend or your wife or your husband behaves in a certain way that

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: gets in your nerves, God is doing it and it's because you deserve it.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
So, you have to get on yourself,
and correct your self,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
and catch yourself objecting, not
submitting to God. God runs everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I wanna give you an example so you
understand how God is running everything

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: and how we have the freedom of choice.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Suppose I had a temporary ability of traveling in the future, let's say for one week.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: I travel in the future and I see what happened to you, what decision you made.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Okay. So, I traveled all the way to the next Friday and
I saw exactly where you went,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
what kind of decision you made. Now back
to this Friday, I'm giving you a choice

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: to go to New York or to California. I wanna give you a

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
choice to go to either New York or
California. So, I'm giving you a choice.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: You're going to freely choose California or New York for your trip,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
but I already know, see, because I travelled in
time this one week and I know that you

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
decided to go to California. So, even
though I'm giving you the freedom of choice,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I know exactly what you're going
to do and where you're going.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
But it is much more than this. I don't
think we can really understand it.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: God runs everything and this is the condition. This is a quality of God and if you

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
don't know this quality, you don't know
God and you don't believe in God.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And this is what the Quran means by all
these verses.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
When Satan inflicts disasters,
diseases, cancer on people,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
Satan is doing this in accordance with God's law,
and we see this in the Quran.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
I remind you of the example of
the disciples of Jesus, when they

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
demanded a feast from the sky, and God said
"okay. I'm gonna send it down but if any

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: of you disbelieves, I will punish him severely more than anybody that I ever punished."

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Now, you know that the punisher would really be Satan,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: but God - this is God's law. When they disbelieve, they step out of God's Kingdom, then Satan will inflict

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: the damage, but God is doing everything. So, even the actions of Satan

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
are under God's control. God is running
everything. God will not be a god if He

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: wasn't running everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
So, this is a quality of God that you
must recognize and we're going to

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
commemorate. This is in our own language,
in English, and you drive your car and

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
you say God is running everything, and
you look at everything and you say God

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
is running everything, because this is
the condition of belief in God.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
The Quran says very clearly
"when something good happens to you, it is from God,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: when something bad happens to you, it is from you," but God is running everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: God created the fire. You can use it to

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
cook a steak from a raw steak
to a delicious cooked steak, unless you like it raw.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
But you can also put your finger in that
fire and burn your finger.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
So, God created the fire to be in your
service, but if you choose to put your

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
finger in it and suffer, then this is
from you, not from God.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: But it is God's law that made the fire as burning. If you put your finger in it, it burns. It's God's law.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
It's one of the physical laws.
There are many invisible laws

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
like if you disobey God,
if you go drink, for example, it's exactly

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
like putting your finger in the fire but
the punishment is not as visible.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: You can be sure you'll pay. It's just like that, like the fire putting your finger in it.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: Alcohol and drinking it, drugs and taking them, adultery and committing it,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: all these things, they're laws that God's laws govern them and the punishment,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
the physical - the fire, putting your finger in it,
the punishment for the sins are exactly in the same way,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text: but they're not as visible. They're just as painful if not worse.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
And this explains all the problems we
see in the world,

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
the people breaking God's law and paying the price,
just like putting their finger in the fire.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
What is our role? What do we do?
God is doing everything.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
We do only one thing, one decision: to be
with God or not.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
After that God takes over.
But we are absolutely free in that decision.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
Text:
To submit is already done, and the choice,
our choice is to willingly submit or unwillingly submit.

Video Title: 12 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa the Most Important Sermon GOD is Doing Everything 1987 06 05
